defaults.permitted_development: Some side extensions can be permitted development in Wales if Class A limits are met and no condition has removed those rights.

rules.height_rules: Single-storey side extensions must not exceed 4m in height. Eaves should not exceed the existing house eaves, and if within 2m of a boundary the eaves should not exceed 3m.
rules.depth_rules: There is no separate side-extension depth metre rule. The key test is whether the resulting house remains no more than 50% wider than the original dwellinghouse and stays within the Welsh highway and boundary controls.
rules.boundary_rules: The resulting dwellinghouse should not exceed the width of the widest part of the original house by more than 50%. Any part within 2m of a boundary should not exceed 4m in height.
rules.roof_rules: For side extensions of more than one storey, the roof pitch should, as far as practical, match the existing dwellinghouse.
rules.materials_rules: External materials should, as far as practicable, match the existing house.
